speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intracranial meningioma causing compressive optic neuropathy.

I am not asking further questions; based on your age, the 3-week history of worsening vision and headache without systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, this clinical picture strongly suggests a space-occupying lesion such as a meningioma. I will need you to undergo imaging to confirm the location and size of the mass. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast.
